Subject: SOC 2 Type II — initial artifact request and timing

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks again for partnering with us on Redwood's SOC 2 Type II review. To scope the audit packet and determine whether we need a bridge letter, could you confirm the following and provide the artifacts listed below? Ideally we'd get the extracts via a shared drive link or SFTP.

Requested items (initial):
- SOC 2 Type II report (final) covering the period Oct 1, 2025 — Sep 30, 2026 (if available)
- Bridge letter if the Type II report does not include the full audit window or if testing exceptions exist
- MFA enforcement logs: time-bounded slice for the audit window (fields: timestamp, user_id/email, application, auth_method, result)
- Access review evidence: last two quarter-end access certification exports (CSV/PDF) and attestation emails
- Privileged account deprovisioning list and approval records for the audit window
- KMS/keystore rotation evidence (rotation timestamps, affected key IDs, and owner attestations)

A few clarifying questions:
1) What is Redwood's preferred delivery format for large log extracts (compressed CSV, parquet)?
2) Are there retention/legal constraints we should be aware of for the raw authn logs?
3) Who is the best technical contact for the log extracts and any redaction requests?

If you can send a short scope matrix and delivery timeline by end of day tomorrow it will help us lock scheduling on our side.

Attachment: audit_request_template.pdf (redacted request checklist)

Thanks,
Dana Holt
Security Audit Lead
Luminous Analytics

Delivery preferences: compressed CSV (gzip) for log extracts works best for our infra team. We can also provide parquet on request.

Proposed owners and timeline:
- MFA logs & authn slices — owner: Karthik Iyer (Engineering, Security infra). ETA for first slice: Dec 9, 2026
- Access review exports & attestation emails — owner: Laura Bennett (Security & Compliance). ETA: Dec 8, 2026

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-12-06T08:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — initial artifact request and timing

Hi Dana/Vanessa —

Quick technical note from engineering on the MFA/authn extracts. We can produce a time-bounded slice that includes the following fields by default:
- event_ts (UTC ISO8601)
- user_email
- application_name
- auth_method (e.g., password+mfa, passkey)
- auth_result (SUCCESS/FAILURE)
- ip_address
- device_id (if available)

We hold raw authn traces for 18 months; extracting the Oct 2025 — Sep 2026 window is straightforward but the CSV will be large (estimated ~1.2M rows). We'll compress to gzip and deliver as incremental chunks (by month). File naming convention: redwood_mfa_YYYYMM.gz.

For KMS rotation: we can provide a signed PDF with rotation timestamps, key IDs, and the owner attestations (internal approvals). See attached kms_rotation_report.pdf.

On redaction: We generally can leave ip_address and device_id intact for auditors, but if your policy requires pseudonymization we can pseudonymize those fields prior to delivery — please confirm.

Attachments included: mfa_log_sample_template.csv, kms_rotation_report.pdf

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Staff Engineer, Infra — Redwood Inference

From: Dana Holt <dana.holt@luminous-analytics.com>
